### 11.2 What We're NOT Liable For  
We're not responsible for:
- ❌ Delays in external systems (payment schemes)
- ❌ Your loss if you disclose your PIN/password
- ❌ Fraud if you were negligent (left card visible)
- ❌ Interest rate changes (variable product)
- ❌ Third-party actions (you authorize)  
---
name: Chunk 30/42

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability Exclusion for External System Delays
raw_entities.description: The bank disclaims liability for delays caused by external payment schemes or systems beyond the bank's direct control. This clause limits the bank's responsibility for timing failures in third-party payment infrastructure.
context: We're not responsible for: Delays in external systems (payment schemes)

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability Exclusion for Customer PIN/Password Disclosure
raw_entities.description: The bank is not liable for losses resulting from the customer's voluntary or negligent disclosure of their PIN or password to third parties. This places responsibility on the customer to maintain confidentiality of authentication credentials.
context: We're not responsible for: Your loss if you disclose your PIN/password

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability Exclusion for Fraud Due to Customer Negligence
raw_entities.description: The bank disclaims liability for fraudulent transactions when the customer has been negligent in protecting their card, such as leaving it visible or unattended. This clause requires customers to exercise reasonable care in safeguarding their payment instruments.
context: We're not responsible for: Fraud if you were negligent (left card visible)

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability Exclusion for Interest Rate Changes
raw_entities.description: The bank is not liable for losses or reduced earnings resulting from changes to interest rates on variable-rate products. This clause clarifies that interest rate fluctuations are a normal feature of variable products and not a breach of contract.
context: We're not responsible for: Interest rate changes (variable product)

raw_entities.name: Bank Liability Exclusion for Third-Party Actions
raw_entities.description: The bank disclaims liability for actions taken by third parties that the customer has authorized. This clause limits the bank's responsibility when customers grant explicit consent to third-party access or transactions.
context: We're not responsible for: Third-party actions (you authorize)
